items.title: Johnny Wiggs Interview, 1962-08-26
items.q: that was the group that Souchon played with

ctx.x: to get on with any music other music there were there any other kid bands or any other dance bands that you heard in those days as you were learning yourself

no uh did you ever sneak around there was no such thing as a kid's band except that in the neighborhood you know neighborhood bands not bands but groups would uh would form of course that was a good deal later on you know when when the kids learned how to play yeah pretty well I got up groups like the invincibles that's the group that I played with and then there was the six and seven eights that was the group that Souchon played with and they had those groups in various neighborhoods the invincibles was around…
I guess the six and seven eights were around St. Charles Avenue well they were scattered I think they were scattered all over town I mean I think they used to rehearse up that right
